summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the four new features (narrated streaming Ask, Impact paths, Saved views, Ingestion Console) + core regression. All four features work end-to-end against the real backend. Signed in with pre-filled bootstrap token (button labelled 'Continue' on /signin). ASK: deterministic mode shows result + evidence (ask-evidence-0..N with hover/title tooltip e.g. 'git://demo/.../README.md') and NO narration card; switching to ask-mode-narrated and submitting renders a separate ask-narration card with 'streaming' indicator + Stop button, text streams from /brain/llm/stream (686 chars arrived in <1s so Stop could not be clicked mid-stream in CI, but ask-stop-stream element renders during streaming), footnote 'Generated by the development simulator — not model inference.' appears when done. GRAPH IMPACT PATHS: graph-mode-paths opens path-source / path-target pickers; picking EOIP-1 and 'service' and clicking path-run returned 3 shortest paths (4 hops each: EOIP-1 → README.md/42 → ... → service.py), paths-list panel rendered them, stats chip shows '3 paths', clicking a chip opens inspector. SAVED VIEWS: graph-views-trigger opens dropdown; graph-view-save stores view with seed count + lens; 'Saved on this device only.' label present; view persists across in-app navigation (/overview → /graph), graph-view-load reloads it (lens + seeds restored), trash button removes it. INGESTION CONSOLE: app-shell-nav-ingestion present; all 4 tabs work; Runs table populated from /ingestion/runs; Jobs empty state 'No background jobs'; Sources shows empty state + 16 connectors grid including connector-jira and connector-gitlab; DLQ loads; ingestion-refresh triggers refetch. REGRESSION: sign-in → overview stats (226 vertices / 721 edges / 0.0142 density / 75 vertex labels / 68 edge labels, Graph by domain bars, System signals ready/disabled/not_created), left-nav routing to all 5 screens, global-search-trigger opens command palette and returns 7 results for 'service', theme-toggle-button present.

issues: Narration streams so fast against the simulator (<1s to deliver ~686 chars) that the Stop button is rarely clickable in practice — functionality is correct, but UX of ask-stop-stream has little real surface area in the simulator. Consider throttling simulated token delivery for a more realistic streaming demo.

Dropdown mounts a fixed inset-0 overlay (z-30) to close on outside click; this overlay briefly intercepts pointer events for left-nav items when the Views dropdown is open — users must dismiss the dropdown before navigating. Minor UX.

action_items: (Optional) Throttle simulated SSE token delivery (/brain/llm/stream simulator) so the streaming indicator & ask-stop-stream are visible for more than a fraction of a second.
(Optional) When Views dropdown is open, let left-nav clicks still work (either lower overlay z-index below the nav or close dropdown on nav click).
critical_code_review_comments: Ask.tsx AnswerModeBadge mode switches to 'Simulated' only when a chunk with usage.is_simulation arrives; works, but relies on backend sending it in at least one chunk — safe for this simulator.

GraphExplorer saved-views overlay uses `fixed inset-0 z-30` for click-outside, which can intercept clicks on the surrounding shell (nav). Consider using an onBlur handler or pointer-events-none shim instead.
seed_data_creation: Created and later cleaned up one saved view named 'TEST_regression_view' in localStorage during the saved-views test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (narrated Ask, Impact paths, Saved views, Ingestion Console tabs/connectors/DLQ) verified working against real backend. Sign-in button text is 'Continue' (not 'Sign in'). IMPORTANT: Auth is in-memory, so Playwright must navigate via in-app nav clicks ([data-testid=app-shell-nav-{overview|ask|graph|ingestion|schema}]) — using page.goto() after sign-in drops the session and bounces back to /signin. 2–3 console 401 errors on /signin are expected (auth verify-then-fallback). Simulator streaming is near-instant so testing Stop mid-stream is unreliable; verify presence of ask-stop-stream during streaming instead.
